newsitem.title: USA: Vail Resorts stake raised by Baron.
newsitem.headline: Vail Resorts stake raised by Baron.

text.p: New York investor Ronald Baron said Tuesday he raised his stake in Vail Resorts Inc to 3,756,100 common shares, or 11.3 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 343,000 common between April 22 and May 2 at prices ranging from $17.8958 to $20.0155 per share.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, BAMCO Inc and Baron Capital Inc, all based in New York. Vail is a Colorado ski resort.
